title: Olympic Swimmer Ryan Lochte Is Engaged! Here's the Sweet Story
summary:
Big news from the swimming world: Ryan Lochte is getting married! The 12-time Olympic medalist shared a video on Instagram showing the moment he asked his girlfriend, Molly Gillihan, to marry him. The actual proposal happened a few days earlier at a restaurant in Gainesville, Florida. That city is special to them—it's where Lochte went to college at the University of Florida, and it's also where they had their very first date.

Lochte, who is 41, wrote a really heartfelt message to Molly in his post. He said she "brought him back to life" when he was feeling lost. He thanked her for believing in him and helping him find himself again. The two started dating in July 2025 and moved in together this past January. Lochte said that was "the right step" for them.

Molly is from Springfield, Missouri, where Lochte will soon be an assistant swim coach at Missouri State University. She went to school right on that same campus! It seems like everything is falling into place for the happy couple. We wish them all the best as they start this new chapter together. Congratulations, Ryan and Molly!
why_it_matters: Ryan Lochte’s story shows that even famous athletes have personal ups and downs, and finding someone to share your life with can happen when you least expect it.
